ladder.teaches: sort, then take the locally best
ladder.why: Every box costs one slot, so sorting by units per box and filling from the top is obviously optimal: the purest form of sort-then-take.
After sorting, the smallest can only pair with the largest if all pair sums are equal, so pairing from both ends is forced.

ladder.teaches: track the furthest reach so far
ladder.why: Reachable indices form windows; keeping the furthest reach of the current window turns a BFS into one O(n) scan.

ladder.teaches: a running balance that resets (gas station)
ladder.why: When the tank goes negative, every start so far is ruled out at once, so reset the balance and move the start past it.

notes: The pool lacked the canonical classics (Jump Game II, Gas Station, Partition Labels, Two City, Task Scheduler, Furthest Building, Refueling Stops, Largest Number, Units on a Truck, Efficient Teams); all were taken from outside any pool and given solutions and repairs. amazon-find-minimum-time-required is the same task as google-task-scheduler-with-cooldown, so it was left out. 'Pair the extremes' has no Boats-to-Save-People problem in the bank; expedia-efficient-teams is the cleanest two-ends pairing.
